dedupe_keys.name: dams under federal supervision switzerland sfoe

description: The Swiss Federal Office of Energy publishes the dams in Switzerland that are under direct federal supervision as official basic geodata (ID 193.1). Each dam point carries the facility, dam and reservoir names, dam type and purpose in German, French and English, year of construction, start of operation and of federal supervision, dam height, crest length, crest level, impoundment and storage levels and impoundment volume. The set is listed on opendata.swiss with CSV, GeoPackage and INTERLIS 2.3 downloads, WMS and WMTS services and the geo.admin.ch REST API, with an annual update cycle; the data status is 28 November 2023 and the dataset was first published in 2011. Downloads are free without registration under the opendata.swiss terms of use set by SFOE. Caveats: only dams under federal supervision are included, so smaller dams supervised by cantons are missing, no hazard or consequence class is given, and the latest data status is from 2023. Simulation uses: a national inventory of large dams and reservoirs for dam-break and flood exposure studies, linking hydropower storage to the electricity system, and emergency planning downstream. Related records: the ICOLD World Register of Dams (data-icold-world-register-of-dams) and the Romanian dam register (data-romania-rebar-national-dam-register) are comparable inventories.
